subject: MAP: Load trial scheduling & capacity asks (traffic replay)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@fastbank.com>
Cc: Mike CorpOps <mike.corpops@fastbank.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: Load trial scheduling & capacity asks (traffic replay)

Hi Emily / Mike —

Thanks again for the call today — good alignment on the test objective and success criteria. Attached is the latest MAP draft (MAP_v0.3.pdf) with the milestones we discussed. I pulled out the immediate next milestone below so we can lock dates and owners:

1) Load trial scheduling (traffic replay) — target window: choose a 3-hour slot in a target week; Redwood to run traffic replay against Dedicated staging pool.
   - Owner (Redwood): Karthik Iyer (performance lead)
   - Owner (FastBank): Emily Cho / Mike CorpOps
   - Deliverables: sampled pcap/traffic export, peak QPS estimate, any IP allowlist for the replay harness
   - Dependencies: security whitelist, procurement approval for dedicated test capacity, sample traffic file in template format

2) Capacity sizing decision — Redwood will propose dedicated pool sizing based on peak QPS + 20% buffer; will provide both dedicated and fallback hosted plan.

3) Post-test validation & cost estimate — Redwood to provide token-level cost breakdown and latency P95/P99 report within 48h of test completion.

Proposed target close date for this MAP milestone set: 2026-09-03 (we're aiming for go/no-go on dedicated capacity by then).

Ask from your side for the scheduling step: can you share two target weeks (in PST) when your infra team can support a staged traffic replay, and a sample traffic export in the attached template (traffic_spec_template.xlsx)? If you already have a compressed capture, feel free to attach — we prefer a sample of peak-minute traffic and a 15-minute representative window.

I've linked the HubSpot MAP record and a replay runbook we typically follow. Karthik will pick up with you on sizing once we have the peak QPS.

Attachments: MAP_v0.3.pdf, traffic_spec_template.xlsx

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

---
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform

From: Emily Cho <emily.cho@fastbank.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike CorpOps <mike.corpops@fastbank.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-20T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Load trial scheduling & capacity asks (traffic replay)

Thanks Monica — appreciated the clear MAP. A couple quick notes from our side: 

- Availability: Ops can support staged replays the weeks of 2026-08-31 or 2026-09-14. Prefer mornings PST (09:00–12:00) for the first window so we can have on-call coverage.
- Security: We have an internal whitelist process; I can get a pre-approval for Redwood's test CIDRs but final approval depends on our SecOps sign-off (expect ~48–72 hours).
- Peak QPS estimate: Preliminary internal estimate is ~12k QPS peak for the endpoint footprint we discussed; we can confirm after exporting the sample.

I've attached a short sample export from our staging capture (fastbank_traffic_snapshot.json.gz) — it's a 1-minute compressed snapshot and a short peak-minute extract. I used your template for the column mapping. Let me know if you need a bigger window.

We'll also need a short mutual action item in HubSpot that lists procurement as a gate — I'll update the MAP record once we lock the date.

Cheers,
Emily Cho
Senior Platform Engineer, FastBank
emily.cho@fastbank.com

Attachment: fastbank_traffic_snapshot.json.gz

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@fastbank.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Mike CorpOps <mike.corpops@fastbank.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Load trial scheduling & capacity asks (traffic replay)

Emily — thanks for the snapshot, that is perfect to start sizing. A few operational clarifications from Redwood side before we lock a slot: 

- Pre-test checklist (short):
  * Confirm test CIDRs to be whitelisted (we'll provide a list of Redwood staging IPs)
  * Provide the exact endpoint hostname and any auth tokens we should use for replay
  * Confirm that the sample includes headers we need for routing (Client-ID, X-Request-ID)

- Initial sizing recommendation: based on the 1-min peak sample and the 12k QPS estimate, we're proposing a dedicated staging pool equivalent to 4 x A100-80GB (or equivalent GPUs) with continuous batching enabled. That should handle peak + 20% buffer and allow headroom for longer sequences. If you'd prefer a smaller burst-capable plan we can propose 2xA100 + hosted fallback, but that will likely increase 95th percentile latency.

- Runbook & responsibilities: I've attached our replay_runbook.md excerpt and linked the shared runbook folder. On Redwood side: I'll own orchestration, Rishi will own monitoring and cost reporting, Monica will manage MAP comms. On FastBank side: Emily / Mike to own allowlist + procurement gating.

Can you confirm: 1) which of the two weeks (Aug 31 or Sep 14) you prefer; 2) whether procurement can sign off within the week after the replay (we need that to meet the 2026-09-03 target). Once you confirm, Monica will update the MAP with the locked date and we'll raise a temporary capacity reservation.

Attachment: replay_runbook.md

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Performance Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Emily Cho <emily.cho@fastbank.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike CorpOps <mike.corpops@fastbank.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T08:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Load trial scheduling & capacity asks (traffic replay)

All — we can commit to the week of 2026-08-31. Prefer Wednesday 2026-09-02 09:00–12:00 PST to give us time to complete the whitelist (Tuesday is tight). Procurement indicated they can accelerate review and we expect sign-off by 2026-09-04, which should keep you within the 2026-09-03 target for the capacity decision (we'll try to move procurement up one day).

Confirming the peak QPS: after a quick internal check we expect the operational peak to be 11.8k–12.4k QPS; I'll provide a cleaned 5-minute peak export by EOD today. We'll also whitelist Redwood staging IPs once you provide the list — please send that and the test auth token.

I'll update the HubSpot MAP and add procurement as a gate. Thanks for the clear next steps — looking forward to the run.

Best,
Emily
